label: Required causal interpretation…: IntendedProfile contains the unchanged…
term: required causal interpretation contract for intended existential-grounding profiles
definition: IntendedProfile contains the unchanged BruteFoundationBoundary.Profile as underlying, an independent abstract classifier and world-indexed thin causal-power predicate, and REQUIRED evidence of abstract/concrete disjointness, actual presence of power bearers and of both causal endpoints, actual outgoing Ontic.Causes implying thin causal power, and the owner commitment that thin causal power implies concrete status at every represented world. P2At and P3At take this wrapper and use the SAME underlying existential-grounding relation. The exercise-to-power requirement fixes the intended interpretation; power-to-concrete is an explicit philosophical framework input, not a theorem about arbitrary predicates.
note: The thin power evidenced by exercising causation need not satisfy an intervention-difference, intrinsic-control or reasons-responsive analysis. Required fields constrain label assignments and exclude outgoing abstract causation without defining concrete as power or making every concrete powerful. Concreteness permits immaterial agency. Actual power possession and causal exercise now require existent bearers/endpoints, without distinctness. No exhaustive classification, incoming-causation ban, support-to-cause map, PSR or WF is added. Existing generic Ontic models and frozen theorems remain unchanged; they satisfy this intended interpretation only if the required fields are supplied. See docs/notes/causal-power-concreteness.md. doubledExample and rigidExample are checked constructor adaptations of the EXACT existing 1079 named root-child profiles. Their old underlying data are unchanged, their abstract classifier is empty (all old candidates concrete), and independent thin power is existence plus root role. No mixed abstract/concrete ontology or actual-world fit is demonstrated. Generic source schemata do not automatically meet the contract. #1103: this #1094 contract does not fix the sense of concrete or require anchors; DEF-ESSE-INTENDED-PROFILE is the intended interpretation under the adopted esse sense. The adapters above cannot meet it.
